verdict.rationale: Firecrawl explicitly supports bulk operations. It can scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously, crawl an entire website, and discover all URLs on a site. Webhooks report batch scrape and crawl job progress, so callers do not need to poll. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of batch-scrape parameters and limits (the evidence is one-line summaries), independent or hands-on confirmation that bulk jobs work at scale.
